title: Software Product Demo
sub: Phrases to present, explain and sell a software product.

cards.def:
a showing of how a product works
हिंदी: डेमो / प्रदर्शन
examples: Let me start the demo.
We have a demo for the client tomorrow.
The demo went well and the client asked for a trial.
Let's rehearse the demo once before the call.

cards.def:
to explain step by step
हिंदी: आपको क़दम-दर-क़दम दिखाना
examples: Let me walk you through the dashboard.
I'll walk you through the new feature.
Can you walk us through the setup process?
I'll walk you through the main screens first.

cards.def:
offering to display your screen
हिंदी: मैं अपनी स्क्रीन साझा करता हूँ
examples: Let me share my screen first.
Can everyone see my screen?
Before we start, let me share my screen.
Let me share my screen so you can follow along.

cards.def:
pointing to something visible
हिंदी: जैसा कि आप देख सकते हैं
examples: As you can see, the report is updated live.
As you can see, it's easy to use.
As you can see, the error rate dropped to zero.
As you can see on this slide, costs are down.

cards.def:
directing attention to something
हिंदी: अगर आप ... देखें
examples: If you look at the top right, you'll see the menu.
If you look at this chart, sales are rising.
If you look at the left panel, you'll find your projects.
If you look at last month's numbers, the trend is clear.

cards.def:
asking the audience to observe something
हिंदी: ध्यान दीजिए कि
examples: Notice that the form saves automatically.
Notice that no refresh is needed.
Notice that the total updates as you type.
Notice that the button turns green when it's ready.

cards.def:
the most important function
हिंदी: मुख्य ख़ूबी
examples: The key feature is real-time sync.
Search is the key feature here.
The key feature for finance teams is automatic reports.
Let me show you the key feature first.

cards.def:
to display the best qualities
हिंदी: प्रदर्शित करना
examples: Today we will showcase our new app.
The demo showcases our latest tools.
The conference is a chance to showcase our work.
We'll showcase three customer stories in the demo.

cards.def:
a general summary
हिंदी: संक्षिप्त परिचय
examples: Let me give you a quick overview.
Here's an overview of the product.
This slide gives an overview of the architecture.
After a short overview, I'll go into the details.

cards.def:
a situation in which a product is used
हिंदी: उपयोग का परिदृश्य
examples: A common use case is invoice tracking.
This use case is popular with teams.
Let me show you a real use case from a customer.
Which use case matters most to your team?

cards.def:
the steps a user takes through a product
हिंदी: उपयोगकर्ता की यात्रा
examples: Let's follow a typical user journey.
The user journey starts at sign-up.
We mapped the user journey from first visit to purchase.
There are too many steps in this user journey.

cards.def:
the path a user follows to complete a task
हिंदी: उपयोगकर्ता का प्रवाह
examples: The user flow is simple.
We shortened the user flow.
Let me show you the user flow for booking a meeting.
A clear user flow reduces support questions.

cards.def:
the process of getting new users started
हिंदी: नए उपयोगकर्ता को जोड़ना / ऑनबोर्डिंग
examples: Onboarding takes under two minutes.
We improved the onboarding experience.
Good onboarding helps users see value quickly.
The onboarding checklist guides users through setup.

cards.def:
to register for a service
हिंदी: साइन-अप करना
examples: Users can sign up with their email.
Click here to sign up.
You can sign up with Google or Microsoft.
Most visitors sign up after the free demo.

cards.def:
to enter an account with credentials
हिंदी: लॉग इन करना
examples: Log in using your password.
Users log in with one click.
You'll need to log in again after an hour.
If you can't log in, reset your password here.

cards.def:
a screen showing key information at a glance
हिंदी: डैशबोर्ड
examples: The dashboard shows live metrics.
Open the dashboard to see trends.
Each team gets its own dashboard.
The dashboard updates every few seconds.

cards.def:
the screen and controls users interact with
हिंदी: इंटरफ़ेस
examples: The interface is clean and simple.
We redesigned the interface.
The interface works the same on phone and laptop.
We kept the interface simple for new users.

cards.def:
easy for people to use
हिंदी: उपयोगकर्ता के अनुकूल
examples: The app is very user-friendly.
It has a user-friendly design.
We made the forms more user-friendly.
A user-friendly app needs less training.

cards.def:
easy to understand without instructions
हिंदी: सहज / आसानी से समझ आने वाला
examples: The layout is intuitive.
Users find it intuitive.
The new editor is far more intuitive.
Good design should feel intuitive.

cards.def:
smooth, with no breaks or problems
हिंदी: निर्बाध / सहज
examples: The integration is seamless.
It offers a seamless experience.
Moving your data over is seamless.
Switching between devices is seamless.

cards.def:
happening instantly as events occur
हिंदी: वास्तविक समय में
examples: Data updates in real time.
You get real-time alerts.
Managers see team progress in real time.
Real-time tracking helps drivers avoid delays.

cards.def:
using just one click
हिंदी: एक क्लिक में
examples: You can export in one click.
Share the report in one click.
You can invite your whole team in one click.
Approve all requests in one click.

cards.def:
moving items with the mouse to place them
हिंदी: खींचकर छोड़ना
examples: Just drag and drop the file.
The editor supports drag and drop.
Drag and drop the cards to reorder tasks.
You can drag and drop images into the email.

cards.def:
to press a button using the mouse
हिंदी: क्लिक करना
examples: Click on the settings icon.
Click on "Save" to continue.
Click on any row to see the details.
Now click on the blue button at the bottom.

cards.def:
to touch a screen button
हिंदी: टैप करना
examples: Tap on the menu to open it.
Tap on the photo to enlarge.
Tap on the bell to see your notifications.
Tap on any item to edit it.

cards.def:
to move around a product
हिंदी: नेविगेट करना / आगे बढ़ना
examples: You can navigate using the sidebar.
Users navigate easily.
You can navigate back with the arrow at the top.
The tabs help users navigate between sections.

cards.def:
to switch something on or off
हिंदी: चालू / बंद करना
examples: Toggle the switch to enable dark mode.
You can toggle notifications.
Toggle this option to hide finished tasks.
Use the toggle to switch between list and grid view.

cards.def:
a menu that opens downward to pick an option
हिंदी: ड्रॉपडाउन मेनू
examples: Choose from the dropdown.
The dropdown lists all teams.
Pick your country from the dropdown.
The dropdown remembers your last choice.

cards.def:
to show only items matching conditions
हिंदी: फ़िल्टर करना
examples: You can filter results by date.
Filter the list by status.
Let me filter the report to show only this week.
You can save filters for later.

cards.def:
a box for typing search terms
हिंदी: सर्च बार
examples: Type the name into the search bar.
The search bar is at the top.
Just type a customer's name in the search bar.
The search bar suggests results as you type.

cards.def:
an alert sent to a user
हिंदी: सूचना / नोटिफ़िकेशन
examples: You'll get a notification when it's done.
Turn off the notifications.
You can choose which notifications you receive.
A notification pops up when someone mentions you.

cards.def:
options for adjusting how a product works
हिंदी: सेटिंग्स
examples: Open settings to change the theme.
The settings page lets you customise.
Language options are in settings.
Admins can change the settings for the whole team.

cards.def:
to change something to suit needs
हिंदी: अपनी ज़रूरत के अनुसार बदलना
examples: You can customise your dashboard.
It is easy to customise.
Customise the colours to match your brand.
Every report can be customised.

cards.def:
to adapt to an individual
हिंदी: व्यक्तिगत बनाना
examples: Personalise your feed in settings.
The app personalises suggestions.
Users can personalise their home screen.
We personalise the emails based on user activity.

cards.def:
to connect with other tools
हिंदी: एकीकृत करना / जोड़ना
examples: It integrates with Slack.
We can integrate with your CRM.
Does it integrate with Microsoft Teams?
It takes five minutes to integrate with your calendar.

cards.def:
a connection between two systems
हिंदी: एकीकरण / इंटीग्रेशन
examples: The integration took a day.
There's a Gmail integration.
Let me show you the Salesforce integration.
Each integration can be turned on in settings.

cards.def:
a way for software to talk to other software
हिंदी: एपीआई / सॉफ़्टवेयर को जोड़ने का तरीक़ा
examples: Our API is well documented.
You can connect using the API.
Developers can pull the data through our API.
The API supports both JSON and CSV.

cards.def:
an add-on that extends a software's features
हिंदी: प्लग-इन / अतिरिक्त सुविधा
examples: Install the plug-in from the store.
There's a plug-in for exports.
The plug-in adds a button to your browser.
We built a plug-in for WordPress.

cards.def:
to make a process run without manual work
हिंदी: स्वचालित करना
examples: The tool automates reporting.
You can automate reminders.
Let's automate the weekly report.
You can automate invoices so they go out on time.

cards.def:
a sequence of steps to complete work
हिंदी: कार्य-प्रवाह
examples: The workflow is fully customisable.
We streamlined the workflow.
Let me show you the approval workflow.
The new workflow saves each manager an hour a week.

cards.def:
to make a process simpler and faster
हिंदी: सुव्यवस्थित करना
examples: The app streamlines approvals.
We streamlined our workflow.
The new form streamlines expense claims.
We want to streamline the hiring process.

cards.def:
able to grow without problems
हिंदी: विस्तार योग्य
examples: The system is highly scalable.
We need a scalable solution.
The platform is scalable to millions of users.
Is this design scalable if traffic doubles?

cards.def:
protected from threats
हिंदी: सुरक्षित
examples: All data is stored securely.
The platform is secure.
Logins are secure with two-factor authentication.
We keep customer data secure at every step.

cards.def:
converted into secret code for protection
हिंदी: एन्क्रिप्टेड / कूटबद्ध
examples: Your data is encrypted.
Messages are encrypted end to end.
Backups are encrypted as well.
All files are encrypted before they're stored.

cards.def:
rules about who can see or do what
हिंदी: पहुँच नियंत्रण
examples: Access control is role-based.
You can manage access control easily.
Access control lets you hide salary data.
Let me show you the access control settings.

cards.def:
authorisation to use a feature
हिंदी: अनुमति
examples: Admins can set permissions.
You need permission to edit.
Only managers have permission to approve.
Ask your admin for permission to export.

cards.def:
depending on a user's job or role
हिंदी: भूमिका-आधारित
examples: Access is role-based.
It has role-based dashboards.
We set up role-based access for each department.
Role-based menus show users only what they need.

cards.def:
analysis of usage data
हिंदी: एनालिटिक्स / आँकड़ों का विश्लेषण
examples: The analytics page shows daily users.
Use analytics to track growth.
Analytics show which features people use most.
You can export analytics to a spreadsheet.

cards.def:
a measure used to track performance
हिंदी: मापदंड / मेट्रिक
examples: We track five key metrics.
Choose the metrics that matter.
Which metric matters most to your business?
This metric shows how many users come back.

cards.def:
useful understanding drawn from data
हिंदी: अंतर्दृष्टि
examples: The tool gives deep insights.
This chart offers valuable insight.
The weekly report gives insight into customer behaviour.
These insights helped the team cut costs.

cards.def:
to send a file to a system
हिंदी: अपलोड करना
examples: Upload your photo here.
Files upload in seconds.
You can upload several files at once.
Upload the contract and we'll fill in the details.

cards.def:
to receive a file from a system
हिंदी: डाउनलोड करना
examples: Download the report below.
You can download it offline.
Download the app from the store.
You can download any report as a PDF.

cards.def:
to keep data matching across devices
हिंदी: सिंक करना / मिलान रखना
examples: Your notes sync across devices.
The app syncs automatically.
Changes sync even after you've been offline.
Your calendar syncs with Google and Outlook.

cards.def:
a saved copy of data
हिंदी: बैकअप
examples: The app takes automatic backups.
Restore from the last backup.
We keep daily backups for thirty days.
You can restore a backup with one click.

cards.def:
working on multiple operating systems
हिंदी: कई प्लेटफ़ॉर्म पर चलने वाला
examples: It's a cross-platform app.
We build cross-platform tools.
Being cross-platform, it runs on Windows and Mac.
We chose a cross-platform framework to save time.

cards.def:
adapting to different screen sizes
हिंदी: हर स्क्रीन के अनुसार ढलने वाला
examples: The design is fully responsive.
It's responsive on mobile.
The responsive layout fits tablets too.
Let me show how responsive it is on a phone.

cards.def:
using few resources, fast and simple
हिंदी: हल्का / कम संसाधन वाला
examples: It's a lightweight tool.
The app is lightweight.
The lightweight app works well on old phones.
We kept the installer lightweight.

cards.def:
an early version released for testing
हिंदी: बीटा संस्करण
examples: We are launching a beta version.
Try the beta version.
The beta version is open to selected customers.
Feedback from the beta version shaped this release.

cards.def:
a small test showing an idea is workable
हिंदी: अवधारणा-प्रमाण
examples: The proof of concept worked.
We presented a proof of concept.
Let's build a proof of concept before committing.
The proof of concept convinced the client.

cards.def:
a basic product with just enough features to test
हिंदी: न्यूनतम व्यावहारिक उत्पाद
examples: We launched the MVP in March.
The MVP has three features.
Our MVP helped us learn what users really need.
We'll add more features after the MVP.

cards.def:
a plan of upcoming features
हिंदी: रोडमैप / भावी योजना
examples: It's on our product roadmap.
Here is the roadmap for next quarter.
Dark mode is on the roadmap for next quarter.
We share our roadmap with key customers.

cards.def:
a summary of changes in a new version
हिंदी: रिलीज़ नोट्स
examples: The release notes list all fixes.
Read the release notes first.
The release notes mention the new export option.
We publish release notes with every update.

cards.def:
a specific problem users face
हिंदी: उपयोगकर्ता की मुख्य परेशानी
examples: We solve a major pain point.
Slow loading is a pain point.
Manual reporting is the biggest pain point for managers.
Tell us about your team's pain points.

cards.def:
the main benefit a product promises
हिंदी: उत्पाद का मुख्य लाभ-वादा
examples: Our value proposition is saving time.
The value proposition is clear.
Our value proposition is simple: less admin, more selling.
Let's open the demo with the value proposition.

cards.def:
a feature that attracts buyers
हिंदी: बिक्री का आकर्षण
examples: Speed is our biggest selling point.
Security is a strong selling point.
Its main selling point is how easy it is to set up.
Price is not our only selling point.

cards.def:
an advantage over rivals
हिंदी: प्रतिस्पर्धी बढ़त
examples: Real-time sync is our competitive edge.
This gives us an edge.
Fast support gives us a competitive edge.
We need a competitive edge in this crowded market.

cards.def:
something that greatly changes things
हिंदी: खेल बदल देने वाली चीज़
examples: This feature is a game-changer.
It's a real game-changer.
Customers say automatic tagging is a game-changer.
Offline mode could be a game-changer for field teams.

cards.def:
a feature that makes a product stand out
हिंदी: अलग पहचान देने वाली ख़ूबी
examples: AI search is our key differentiator.
What's your differentiator?
Our biggest differentiator is the price.
Ease of use is the main differentiator.

cards.def:
the person who finally uses a product
हिंदी: अंतिम उपयोगकर्ता
examples: The end user sees a simple screen.
We designed it for the end user.
We tested the design with real end users.
The end user never sees this setting.

cards.def:
a request to hold questions until the finish
हिंदी: सवाल अंत में
examples: Please keep questions for the end.
I'll take questions at the end.
I'll leave time for questions at the end.
We'll have ten minutes for questions at the end.

cards.def:
checking audience understanding
हिंदी: अब तक कोई सवाल?
examples: Any questions so far?
Pause here—any questions so far?
Before I continue, any questions so far?
Any questions so far about the setup?

cards.def:
inviting the audience to speak up
हिंदी: बताइए अगर
examples: Let me know if anything is unclear.
Let me know if you want a closer look.
Let me know if you'd like to see the mobile version.
Let me know if I'm going too fast.

cards.def:
a demo using the real product at that moment
हिंदी: लाइव डेमो
examples: We'll do a live demo now.
The live demo went smoothly.
A live demo is more convincing than slides.
We have a backup video in case the live demo fails.

cards.def:
filmed or saved before the event
हिंदी: पहले से रिकॉर्ड किया हुआ
examples: This is a pre-recorded demo.
The video is pre-recorded.
We'll use a pre-recorded video for the conference.
The pre-recorded demo avoids network problems.

cards.def:
hoping nothing goes wrong
हिंदी: उम्मीद है सब ठीक रहे
examples: Fingers crossed the demo works.
Fingers crossed, here we go.
Fingers crossed the internet holds up.
Fingers crossed the client likes it.

cards.def:
please be patient
हिंदी: थोड़ा धैर्य रखिए
examples: Bear with me, it's loading.
Bear with me for a moment.
Bear with me while I log in.
Please bear with me; the connection is slow.

cards.def:
asking for brief patience
हिंदी: एक पल कृपया
examples: One moment please, it's loading.
One moment please while I switch screens.
One moment please — I'm opening the file.
One moment please while I find that page.

cards.def:
moving to another screen or tab
हिंदी: मैं ... पर चला जाता हूँ
examples: Let me switch to the report view.
Let me switch to the mobile app.
Let me switch to the admin view.
Let me switch to my phone to show the app.

cards.def:
going to the next point
हिंदी: अब आगे ... की ओर
examples: Moving on to reports now.
Moving on to pricing.
Moving on to integrations.
Now, moving on to the last section.

cards.def:
to give a short final summary
हिंदी: संक्षेप में
examples: To sum up, the tool saves time.
To sum up, it's simple and secure.
To sum up, setup takes five minutes.
To sum up, you get faster reports and fewer errors.

cards.def:
what the customer should do next
हिंदी: आपके अगले क़दम
examples: The next steps for you are to sign up.
Next steps for you — book a trial.
I'll email the next steps for you after this call.
The next steps for you are to invite your team.

cards.def:
a period of using a product free of charge
हिंदी: मुफ़्त परीक्षण
examples: Start your free trial today.
We offer a thirty-day free trial.
The free trial includes all features.
No card is needed for the free trial.

cards.def:
to begin using something
हिंदी: शुरू कीजिए
examples: It takes a minute to get started.
Click to get started.
Here's how to get started in three steps.
Our team can help you get started.

cards.def:
a set of costs and features offered
हिंदी: मूल्य-योजना
examples: Choose a pricing plan that fits.
Our pricing plans start low.
The business pricing plan includes priority support.
You can change your pricing plan at any time.

cards.def:
regular payment for ongoing access
हिंदी: सदस्यता
examples: The subscription renews monthly.
Cancel the subscription anytime.
An annual subscription saves you twenty percent.
Your subscription includes all future updates.

cards.def:
the gradual release of a product
हिंदी: चरणबद्ध लॉन्च
examples: The rollout begins next month.
A phased rollout is planned.
The rollout will start with ten percent of users.
We paused the rollout to fix a bug.

cards.def:
to become available for real use
हिंदी: लाइव होना
examples: The site goes live on Monday.
We go live next week.
The new checkout will go live after testing.
Once we go live, support will be on standby.

cards.def:
how something works internally
हिंदी: अंदर से / पर्दे के पीछे
examples: Let me show what's under the hood.
Under the hood, it uses caching.
Under the hood, every action is logged.
Let's look under the hood at how syncing works.

cards.def:
ready to use without extra setup
हिंदी: सीधे इस्तेमाल के लिए तैयार
examples: It works out of the box.
The tool comes with templates out of the box.
Single sign-on works out of the box.
Most teams use it out of the box with no changes.

cards.def:
seen quickly without effort
हिंदी: एक नज़र में
examples: You see all sales at a glance.
The dashboard gives status at a glance.
See overdue tasks at a glance.
The colour codes show risk at a glance.

cards.def:
one stage at a time
हिंदी: क़दम-दर-क़दम
examples: I'll explain it step by step.
Follow the steps step by step.
The guide takes you through setup step by step.
Let's build the report step by step.

cards.def:
involving direct practical use
हिंदी: व्यावहारिक रूप से स्वयं करना
examples: Let's try a hands-on session.
The workshop is hands-on.
After the demo, there's a hands-on session.
Hands-on practice helps users learn faster.

cards.def:
how many people start using a product
हिंदी: उपयोगकर्ताओं द्वारा अपनाया जाना
examples: User adoption has doubled.
We track user adoption weekly.
Training improves user adoption.
Low user adoption is our biggest risk.
